When Gwydion was young, he was a real carouser and debauchee. He probably visited all the brothels in Brakada, which caused him to suffer from troublesome diseases more than once. This greatly influenced the development of his career. Today, Gwydion is the most respected medical specialist in all of Bracada.

mod.name: New Skills Pack
mod.description:
Adds 5 new secondary skills:
• Anatomy – chance to deal double damage
• Fury – increases number of enemies slain
• Impact – reduces enemy defense
• Magic Fader – blocks high-level spellcasting
• Nimbleness – lowers enemy attack through dodging

Each skill features unique animations, effects, and specialized heroes.
mod.anatomy.name: Anatomy
mod.anatomy.description:
Allows your units to detect weak spots in enemies:
• Chance to deal double damage: 5% / 10% / 15% based on skill level
• Random learning of this skill is extremely rare

• Adds new heroes specializing in Anatomy:
    • Teressa for Necropolis
    • Gwydion for Tower
mod.fury.name: Fury
mod.fury.description:
Battle Fury increases the number of enemies killed by your units:
• Increase: 5% / 10% / 15% based on skill level
• Random learning of this skill is extremely rare

• Adds new heroes specializing in Fury:
    • Ex for Inferno
    • Aldarion for Dungeon
mod.impact.name: Impact
mod.impact.description:
The incredible speed and strength of your units' attacks reduces enemy defense:
• Reduction: 5% / 10% / 15% based on skill level
• Random learning of this skill is extremely rare

• Adds new heroes specializing in Impact:
    • Bjorn for Castle
    • Tharag for Stronghold
mod.magic-fader.name: Magic Fader
mod.magic-fader.description:
Blocks selected spells from being cast by the enemy hero during battle:
• Skill level determines which spells are blocked:
    • Basic: blocks level 5 spells
    • Advanced: blocks level 4–5 spells
    • Expert: blocks level 3–5 spells

• Random learning of this skill is extremely rare
mod.nimbleness.name: Nimbleness
mod.nimbleness.description:
Allows your units to partially avoid enemy attacks, reducing their attack:
• Reduction: 5% / 10% / 15% based on skill level
• Random learning of this skill is extremely rare

• Adds new heroes specializing in Nimbleness:
    • Ellaria for Rampart
    • Newt for Fortress
mod.omnimancy.name: Omnimancy
mod.omnimancy.description:
Allows casting spells from all elemental schools at lower mana cost and increased power:
• Basic: reduced mana cost
• Advanced: reduced cost and improved effect
• Expert: minimal cost and maximum effect

• Replaces Fire, Water, Air, and Earth Magic
• Heroes who previously started with these schools now start with Omnimancy

• In Conflux towns, the University now offers: Learning, Intelligence, Sorcery, and Scholar
mod.omnimancy.disablemagic.name: Disable individual magic skill
mod.omnimancy.disablemagic.description: Disable Magic of Fire, Water, Wind and Ground
mod.trapmaster.name: Trapmaster
mod.trapmaster.description: Adds a new secondary skill: Trap Master. At the start of combat, it places spike pits and bear traps.
